ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Dominantly low-intensity ventral surface with high-intensity (white) pixel features covering approximately 10-15% of the visible surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast white circular rings and semi-circles distributed across both lobes; a prominent, high-intensity linear vertical mark is visible on the upper-inner quadrant of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute, deep V-shaped notch at the central axis dividing the two lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular and frequent serrations (peaks and valleys) along the entire trailing edge boundary, isolated against the lighter water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the distal margins of both lobes, tapering to sharp, pointed lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High density of circular and elliptical white rings clustered on the mid-section of the left lobe and scattered across the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several distinct white linear streaks; notably one vertical streak on the right lobe and multiple diagonal marks on the left lobe that disrupt the dark pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive circular scarring consistent with barnacle colonization and linear abrasions/rake marks across the ventral surface.
